title: One query, two clusters

scenes.heading: Do both GPUs need this setting?
scenes.sub: A script wants one exact value
voice: A deployment script needs one GPU Operator setting.
Check the resolved value for each accelerator instead of copying a default.

scenes.heading: Ask the same question twice
voice: Keep EKS, Ubuntu, and training fixed.
Run the AICR query twice with the selector for the GPU Operator kernel module configuration name, once for H100 and once for GB200.

scenes.heading: One setting, two answers
scenes.sub: Values from the tagged query demo
voice: For H100, the setting is unset in this example.
The GB200 recipe returns the NVIDIA kernel module parameter configuration name, which that accelerator needs.

scenes.heading: Use the resolved answer
scenes.sub: Keep the target explicit in the script
voice: The script can use the returned value while keeping its target criteria explicit.
Query is useful when you need the effective setting rather than the full recipe.

payoff: Hold the query selector fixed and see it return different kernel-module settings for two real recipe targets.
